definitions.gloss: one after another, in succession, continuously
definitions.explanation: Events or things occurring or being done in rapid sequence without interruption.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{次々|つぎつぎ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{次々|つぎつぎ}⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: New products were released one after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{お客|きゃく}さん→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{次々|つぎつぎ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {次々|つぎつぎ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do ~ one after another)
- {次々|つぎつぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do ~ in succession)

Both {次々|つぎつぎ}と and {次々|つぎつぎ}に are used interchangeably, though と may slightly emphasize the continuous nature.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {次々|つぎつぎ}: One after another (rapid succession)
- ⟦{続々|ぞくぞく}→続々：00436_zokuzoku⟧: One after another (similar meaning, often for people arriving)
- ⟦{相次|あいつ}いで→相次いで：15419_aitsuide⟧: In succession, one after another (more formal)
